meta.title: Apache Radar
meta.description: Official Apache counts by source, watched activity and local Chinese weekly briefs; no model API key required.

messages.command.description: Apache source scopes, watch list and local Chinese weekly briefs
messages.command.hint: help | counts | watch [add|remove project-id] | refresh | brief | open | lookup query
messages.command.help:
Apache Radar: a local radar for official Apache source scopes and watched projects.

/apache-radar counts: compare official counts, retired scopes, mismatches and multi-label categories.
/apache-radar watch: show the watch list; watch add spark / watch remove spark: edit project ids.
/apache-radar refresh: collect counts and watched feeds through the one-hour TTL cache; no brief is written.
/apache-radar brief: write a copyable Chinese Markdown weekly brief; open: read the latest brief; lookup KIP-1356: search collected original links.
/apache-radar help: show help.

Every count has its source URL and fetch time in Asia/Singapore (UTC+8), plus the source timestamp when available. Retired scopes stay side by side and known mismatches remain visible.
Default watch list: Kafka / Hadoop / Flink. Default window: rolling last 7 days. Failures retain last-good cache timestamps and errors; a failed source does not mean no updates.
Releases use official catalogues and project originals; GitHub Releases is not an authority. JIRA / fixVersion and accepted proposals do not prove shipment. Hadoop has no verified general HIP index.
Cache, watch overrides and briefs use .apache-radar-* files in the current session directory. Local watch overrides take precedence over plugin config. Without the directory service, the initial project directory is used. Traversal and symlinks are rejected.
Chat tools apache_radar_refresh / counts / watch / brief / open / lookup return summaries, statuses, paths and links by default. Tool open includes full Markdown only with includeMarkdown. Lookup uses collected data without network or upgrade verdicts.
reporter.apache.org is not used. No model API key or model call is required.
messages.command.noArgs: This action accepts no extra arguments or paths; use /apache-radar help.
messages.command.watchUsage: Usage: /apache-radar watch [add|remove project-id]; for example watch add spark.
messages.command.lookupUsage: Usage: /apache-radar lookup item-id, version or title keywords.
messages.command.failed: Action {action} failed; local data directory: {directory}. Reason: {error}
messages.command.noDirectory: No valid current session directory; path escape rejected.
messages.command.watchPath: Local override file: {path} (saved only after an edit)
messages.command.openHint: Use /apache-radar open to read and copy the brief.
messages.command.sources: ## Feed source statuses (failure does not mean no updates)
messages.command.noMatches: No collected items matched; this does not mean no updates.
messages.command.more: Only the first twenty matches are shown; narrow the query.
messages.config.watchList: Watched project ids in display order; defaults to kafka / hadoop / flink
messages.errors.extraArgs: Extra arguments or caller-supplied paths are not accepted.
messages.errors.directory: Apache Radar needs a valid current session directory; path escape rejected.
messages.errors.guard: Apache Radar rejects calls without a valid current directory and path escapes.
messages.errors.invalidProject: Invalid project id; use letters, digits and hyphens, as in kafka, hadoop or flink.
messages.errors.local: Local directory, state, cache or brief operation failed. Technical detail: {error}
messages.errors.source: Source request or payload parsing failed: {error}
messages.errors.noBrief: No local brief; run brief first.
messages.errors.noCollection: No collected activity; run refresh or brief first.
messages.errors.unwatched: The requested project is not watched.
messages.errors.query: Enter an item id, version or title keywords.
messages.lookup.offline: Searching collected data only; refresh this source separately.
messages.lookup.expired: Cache expired; searching collected data without refreshing.
messages.lookup.note: Only collected linked items are searched; undated items are not new this week. No match does not mean no updates. No compatibility or production-upgrade verdicts.
messages.collection.note: Source failures and last-good cache times are retained; undated proposals are not new this week. Use lookup to search collected items and open to read the brief.
messages.display.unknownDate: Unknown (reference item, not new this week)
messages.counts.currentNote: Current chooser TLPs plus podlings; not a single official total.
messages.counts.tlpsNote: Deduplicate chooser PMC ids, exclude Incubator and Attic, and cross-check committee sources.
messages.counts.chooserPodlingsNote: Chooser projects whose PMC is incubator.
messages.counts.publicPodlingsNote: Only status=current; excludes graduated and retired podlings.
messages.counts.atticPmcsNote: Only PMC rows in the Attic table.
messages.counts.atticSubprojectsNote: Only Subproject rows in the Attic table; never merged into one retired total.
messages.counts.retiredComparisonNote: Compare original ids; preserve differences between source scopes without inferring a mapping or reconciling totals.
messages.counts.tlpCheck: Chooser TLPs ↔ Whimsy PMCs excluding Incubator and Attic
messages.counts.tlpCheckNote: Exclude Incubator and Attic by committee id; compare lists as well as counts.
messages.counts.podlingCheckNote: Remove the incubator- prefix from chooser podling ids; retain list differences.
messages.counts.categoryNote: Official multi-label domain tags; category counts cannot be added as a project total.
messages.counts.explanation: Source scopes are shown side by side. Currently listed = current chooser TLPs + podlings, cross-checked against Whimsy PMCs excluding Incubator and Attic. Retired scopes remain separate without one combined total.
messages.counts.table: | Scope | Count / status | Source and time | Notes |
messages.brief.noItems: No collected items are listed within the window; check source statuses. Failed or partial sources do not mean no updates this week.
messages.brief.noUndated: No undated items are listed in the collected data.
messages.brief.undatedTitle: #### Undated reference items (not new this week)
messages.feed.jiraWarning: JIRA issues and fixVersion / New Feature do not constitute a complete shipped-feature list.
messages.feed.partialJira: Partial JIRA response; other pages were not scanned, so this is not complete window coverage.
messages.feed.undatedJira: Some JIRA issues lack dates and are listed as undated references.
messages.feed.skippedProposal: Proposal row skipped because it has no original link.
messages.feed.undatedProposals: The index provides no item dates; undated proposals are references, not new this week.
messages.feed.notesMissing: Catalogued; no release notes found, so no changes are inferred.
messages.feed.noJira: No verified anonymous JIRA adapter for this project.
messages.feed.noHip: Hadoop has no verified general HIP index; the research candidate returned 404. No HIP table is fetched or invented.
messages.feed.noProposal: No verified proposal index for this project.
messages.feed.window: Rolling last {days} days: {start} to {end} (inclusive); date-only items use UTC+8 midnight. Undated items are separate references outside the window.
messages.counts.difference: {status}; Only on left: {left}; Only on right: {right}
messages.tools.lookup: Search only collected linked items by id, version or title; no compatibility or safe-upgrade inferences.
messages.tools.open: Return the latest brief path; includeMarkdown defaults to false and explicitly enables full Chinese Markdown.
messages.tools.summary: One-hour cache TTL; return source scopes, timestamps, failures and paths without issue bodies.
messages.tools.description: {action}: local Apache radar. {detail} Uses the current session directory.
messages.errors.localTraversal: Local directory traversal or invalid filename rejected.
messages.errors.localDirectory: Local directory symlink or invalid directory rejected.
messages.errors.localTarget: Local target symlink or non-file rejected.
